traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Musaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; veins pinnate; blades lanceolate, oblong or ovate; plants monoecious or polygamous; ovary inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers zygomorphic; irregular flowers bilabiate; perianth tepals; fruit berry; stamens 5 to 6; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.
